BEFORE YOU BEGIN

A few things you might be wondering.

About building internal tools with Atomic.

What templates are available for teams?

Pipeline CRM includes companies, contacts, staged deals, an activity log, and a dashboard. Help Desk includes requests, an agent queue, internal notes, and a knowledge base. Both are documented starting points you can adapt.

Can colleagues help build the app?

Yes. Shared workspaces and invited app collaborators are included in the proposed paid plans, with Editor and Admin roles. These building permissions are separate from the roles of people using your finished app.

Can I connect an existing business system?

Include the system and the required data flow in your brief. A connection needs a supported API, credentials, and implementation and testing. These pages do not promise ready-made integrations or automatic spreadsheet imports.

Can I restore a previous version?

Atomic supports verified source history and frontend rollback. Restoring source or rolling back a published frontend does not restore business data. Plan data recovery separately and review the versioning guide.
